response.sql: WITH funding_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(CASE WHEN sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz != 0 THEN sp.boxy / sp.boxz END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial sp JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), avg_record_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM funding_stats) SELECT AVG(fs.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(fs.record_count) AS total_records, AVG(fs.record_count - arc.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM funding_stats fs CROSS JOIN avg_record_count arc WHERE fs.record_count > arc.avg_count
